item: 0846/0849 (0828 unit 2): Codex3 direct certificate lookup for non-genesis W3-minus points (FROM_CODEX3/0701)
reviewer_lane: Claude3 (helper cross-family lens 14:45-15:08Z; lead re-verified both blocking findings from bytes)

findings.label: FORMAL (lead, from bytes) + TESTED (helper, synthetic seam probe P2)
findings.title: The builder's full-verify replay refuses every honest real request
findings.evidence: builder L392-403 replays verify_list with real custody (N.A.real_custody_fn) inside Snapshot.reads(). reads() (L205-217) routes every open under /Users/bgm/Research/ through raw() (L135) -> safe_path (L95) -> lexical (L83-93), whose bad list includes 'runs' (L87). The frozen C1 custody deriver calib_tail_readiness_cx2/certificates_per_point/custody_cx2v002.py 6810b7c3 L129 calls the driver's uvt_static_pins(False). Driver r5 b5cc62af L1215-1223 verify_pins UVT_MONITOR_PINS, whose 'a2f10_result' (L343) is .../CLAUDE2/runs/A2_ANCHOR_F10_RUN_V001/result.json. The result is PROTECTED_PATH_REFUSED on every point, then FULL_VERIFY_REPLAY_MISMATCH at L403. The honest verify step outside the snapshot, guard014 lexical_path (L58-66) and the c3v005 path policy do not refuse this path. Codex3's suite injects a lambda custody, so it cannot see it.

findings.label: FORMAL (lead) + TESTED (helper P2)
findings.title: The preflight bridge refuses every call admitted through it
findings.evidence: bridge L64-68 runs _certificate_check_snapshot inside s.reads(). Custody comes from the pinned deriver (L80-82, the same uvt_static_pins read), and the except at L188-189 returns {'ok': False, 'blockers': ['Refusal: PROTECTED_PATH_REFUSED']}. guard014 then refuses with NATIVE_GATE_REFUSED (L258). Codex3's InertBaseContext and synthetic custody loader hide this.
